text.en:
The Chairman of the Civil Service Commission shall sit as an Ex-
Officio member of the Board of Trustees of the Government Service Insurance
System, Employees' Compensation Commission and the Home Development Mutual
Fund and the Board of Directors of the Philippine. Health Insurance Corporation
pursuant to Section 14, Chapter 3, Title 1-A, Book V of Executive Order No. 292
(Administrative Code of 1987).

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of FEB, in the year of Our
Lord, Two Thousand and Ten.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
POMA Hologram • 54815
